findings.title: Conflicting canonical tags on all 57 pages
findings.description: Every page carries two <link rel=canonical>: a hardcoded homepage canonical from index.html:14, then react-helmet's correct per-page one. Google's December 2025 JavaScript SEO guidance states that when a raw-HTML canonical differs from a JS-injected one it may use either. If it takes the first, 56 of 57 pages declare themselves duplicates of the homepage. Cause: react-helmet-async replaces singleton elements like <title> but appends <meta> and <link>, leaving the static tag in front.
findings.recommendation: Delete the hardcoded canonical at index.html:14 (and the description at index.html:11, same mechanism). Verify each page then reports exactly one canonical.

findings.title: Unknown URLs return HTTP 200 (soft-404)
findings.description: /no-such-page-xyz returns 200 OK with the app shell. The SPA rewrite sends every unmatched path to index.html, so typos, stale links and crawler-invented URLs become indexable pages under a success status. Google treats these as soft-404s, wasting crawl budget.
findings.recommendation: Serve a genuine 404 status for paths outside the known route list via vercel.json, or emit a prerender-time 404 for unmatched routes. The NotFound route already exists in the app.

findings.title: Security headers missing
findings.description: Only Strict-Transport-Security is present. Absent: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options (or CSP frame-ancestors), Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Content-Security-Policy. HSTS also lacks includeSubDomains and preload.
findings.recommendation: Add them in vercel.json headers. The header block in firebase.json does not apply, because the live domain is served by Vercel rather than Firebase Hosting.

findings.title: Duplicate meta description on every page, stale one first
findings.description: Every page ships two meta description tags: a hardcoded sitewide one at index.html:11, then react-helmet's correct per-page one. Engines generally take the first, so the per-page descriptions already written in config/seo.ts are very likely never used and all 57 pages present the same snippet.
findings.recommendation: Delete the hardcoded meta description from index.html:11. Helmet already supplies one on every route.

findings.title: Two H1s per page, the first identical sitewide
findings.description: index.html:100 places an H1 inside the noscript fallback. It precedes the real per-page H1 in the raw HTML of all 57 pages, so every page has two H1s and the first is generic homepage text.
findings.recommendation: Remove the noscript block; prerendering supersedes its purpose.

findings.title: Desktop LCP 3056ms; the LCP image cannot be preload-scanned
findings.description: The LCP element on both viewports is the hero poster, rendered in HeroVideo.tsx:45 as a CSS background-image on a div. A CSS background is discovered only after CSS parses and the element lays out, so the preload scanner never sees it, and there is no link rel=preload in index.html. On desktop the ~1MB hero video downloads concurrently and competes for bandwidth, which is why desktop is nearly 3x slower than mobile, where the video is skipped.
findings.recommendation: Add for the hero poster, or render it as a real with fetchpriority="high". Optionally defer the video until after LCP; preload="metadata" is already correct.
